result.instructions: Tools for ActiveTrail, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many email and SMS credits does our ActiveTrail account have left?"; "Add jane@example.com to the 'Newsletter' group."; "Show the open and click statistics for our last email campaign.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ActiveTrail data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run activetrail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run activetrail_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run activetrail_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. activetrail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: activetrail_get_account_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Email and SMS credit balance and the coupon-list balance of the account. Cheapest authenticated call, also used as the login check. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/account/balance.

tools.name: activetrail_list_sending_profiles
tools.title: List sending profiles
tools.description: Sender profiles (from name and address) the account can send email campaigns from. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/account/sendingprofiles.

tools.name: activetrail_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Search the account's contacts by email or SMS text, optionally by last-updated date range. Paginated. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/contacts.

search_term.description: Search text (name, or email/SMS for contacts).

tools.name: activetrail_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One contact by id: email, SMS, name, state, opt-in flag and custom fields (ext1-ext17). ActiveTrail API: GET /api/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: activetrail_get_contact_groups
tools.title: Get a contact's groups
tools.description: The groups a contact belongs to. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/contacts/{id}/groups.

tools.name: activetrail_get_contact_activity
tools.title: Get a contact's activity
tools.description: The activity log of one contact (sends, opens, clicks and similar events). ActiveTrail API: GET /api/contacts/{id}/activity.

tools.name: activetrail_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: Contact groups of the account, optionally filtered by name. Paginated. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/groups.

search_term.description: Search text (name, or email/SMS for contacts).

tools.name: activetrail_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: One contact group by id, with its name and member counters. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/groups/{id}.

tools.name: activetrail_list_group_members
tools.title: List group members
tools.description: Contacts in one group, optionally filtered by text or last-updated date range. Paginated. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/groups/{id}/members.

search_term.description: Search text (name, or email/SMS for contacts).

tools.name: activetrail_add_group_member
tools.title: Add a contact to a group
tools.description: Create a contact (by email or SMS) and add it to a group. Adding can start automations that use the group as a trigger. It does not send a campaign. ActiveTrail API: POST /api/groups/{id}/members.

email.description: Email address. Required when sms is not given.

sms.description: Phone number for SMS. Required when email is not given.

annotations.title: Add a contact to a group

tools.name: activetrail_list_mailing_lists
tools.title: List mailing lists
tools.description: Mailing lists of the account (id and name). ActiveTrail API: GET /api/mailinglist.

tools.name: activetrail_list_mailing_list_members
tools.title: List mailing list members
tools.description: Contacts of one mailing list, optionally by last-updated date range. Paginated. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/mailinglist/{id}/members.

tools.name: activetrail_list_campaigns
tools.title: List email campaigns
tools.description: Email campaigns, optionally filtered by mailing list, category, name, send type or last-updated date range. Paginated. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/campaigns.

mailing_list_id.description: Only campaigns for this mailing list id.

content_category_id.description: Only campaigns in this category id.

search_term.description: Search text (name, or email/SMS for contacts).

send_type.description: Send type filter, one of the values the API reference lists.

tools.name: activetrail_get_campaign
tools.title: Get an email campaign
tools.description: One email campaign by id: name, subject, send type, sent state and totals. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: activetrail_get_campaign_report
tools.title: Get an email campaign report
tools.description: Summary statistics (sent, opens, clicks, rates, conversions) of one email campaign, optionally for a date range. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/campaignreports/{id}.

tools.name: activetrail_list_automations
tools.title: List automations
tools.description: Marketing automations of the account, optionally filtered by state. Paginated. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/automations.

state_type.description: Automation state filter, one of the values the API reference lists.

tools.name: activetrail_get_automation
tools.title: Get an automation
tools.description: One automation by id: template, trigger type, trigger object and how many contacts started it. ActiveTrail API: GET /api/automations/{id}.

tools.name: activetrail_list_signup_forms
tools.title: List sign-up forms
tools.description: Sign-up forms of the account (id and name). ActiveTrail API: GET /api/signupforms.

tools.name: activetrail_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact in the account by email or SMS, with optional name, phone and city. The API rejects a duplicate; check with activetrail_list_contacts first. ActiveTrail API: POST /api/contacts.

email.description: Email address. Required when sms is not given.

sms.description: Phone number for SMS. Required when email is not given.
